description: Plan responsive breakpoints from content. Pass `contentWidths` (list of px widths where your layout starts to fail or needs to change, found by dragging the browser or frame), and optionally `deviceTargets` (px widths of devices you must support; these are checked against the result, never used to create breakpoints), `minMeasure` (default 45 characters) and `maxMeasure` (default 75) for text columns, `fontSize` (default 16), `gutter` (default 24), `margin` (default 24), `maxColumns` (default 3), and `fluidMin` and `fluidMax` (viewport range for the fluid rules, default 320 and 1440). Returns breakpoints (your content widths plus widths derived from how many columns at the minimum measure fit, and where one column reaches the maximum measure), a container max-width for each, ready CSS, fluid clamp() rules for body size, h1, gutter and page padding computed so they hit exact minimum and maximum at the range ends, a note for any two breakpoints within 10% of each other, and for each device target whether it is already near a breakpoint. Sources: Marcotte, Responsive Web Design (breakpoints follow the design). The 45 to 75 character measure, the 0.5em average character width and the 10% closeness test are conventions. Pure arithmetic, nothing stored.

contentWidths.description: Widths in px where the layout needs to change. Comma separated string also accepted.

deviceTargets.description: Device widths to check against the result, for example [390, 768, 1280].

margin.description: Page margin per side in px (default 24).

maxColumns.description: Most text columns you will show (default 3, max 6).

name: plan_breakpoints
title: Breakpoint planner
